faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICAR CIRCOT SRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position is 21st September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in specific fields like Renewable Energy, Agricultural Process Engineering, Textile Chemistry, or equivalent is required, along with a 4/5 years Bachelor's degree. NET qualification may be necessary in some cases.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the SRF position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post is 40 years. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the SRF post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37,000 plus applicable House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the SRF position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for the ICAR CIRCOT SRF recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the ICAR CIRCOT located?
faq.answer: ICAR Central Institute for Research on Cotton Technology (ICAR CIRCOT) is located in Mumbai, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is A-12024/1/2026-Adm-I-CIRCOT.

faq.question: Q10. Are there any age relaxations provided?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxations are provided: 3 years for OBC, 5 years for SC/ST, and 10 years for Persons with Disabilities (PH).
